admin.intro: Each story is reviewed before publication. Reject or remove any story that gives a health or disability detail, information about another person (a child in particular), abusive language, advertising, or that promises someone help or a decision. You never see the author's account or who reported.
admin.problems: To fix before publication (the story cannot be edited: reject it with a reason)
admin.title: Story moderation
closed: This feature is not open yet. It will open once its data protection impact assessment has been validated.
failed: The stories could not be loaded.
form.consent: I agree that this story is published on the site under my pseudonym, after review. I can withdraw my agreement at any time: the story is then removed from the site and its text erased.
form.health_warning: Do not give any detail about your health, a disability or a treatment, nor any information that could identify another person, a child in particular (name, address, school, phone). It is not needed: a story that contains such details is not published.
form.sent: Thank you. Your story will be reviewed before it is published. You can withdraw it at any time.
form.text_only: Text only: no photo, file, link, email address, phone number or social media account. Only the title, the text and your pseudonym are published.
form.title: Tell a story
join.done: Your pseudonym is saved. You can now tell your story.
join.help: This is the only name shown next to your stories. Do not use your name, your email address or a number. 3 to 24 letters or digits, “-” or “_”, no space. It cannot be changed later.
join.label: Pseudonym
join.title: Choose a pseudonym
list.intro: People tell, under a pseudonym, about their path and what helped them. Each story is published with its author's agreement, after review. The author can withdraw it at any time.
list.notice: A story tells a personal experience: every situation is different, and only the body concerned decides on yours.
list.title: Community stories
member.leave_help: Leaving the community withdraws all your stories (their text is erased) and deletes your pseudonym.
member.left: You have left the community: your stories are withdrawn and your pseudonym deleted.
member.title: Your pseudonym
mine.erased: The text of this story has been erased.
mine.intro: Stories are published under a pseudonym, after review. The community is reserved for accounts of people aged 18 or over. You can withdraw a story at any time.
mine.login_required: Sign in to join the community or withdraw a story.
mine.pending_max: You already have several stories awaiting review. You can send another one after the decision.
mine.title: My stories
mine.withdraw_help: Withdrawal is immediate: the story is no longer visible and its text is erased.
mine.withdrawn: Your story is withdrawn and its text erased.
problem.adult: The community is reserved for accounts of people aged 18 or over.
problem.contact: No link, email address or social media account in the story.
problem.image: No image, code or formatting: text only.
problem.limit: You have reached the number of stories possible for today.
problem.pending: You already have too many stories awaiting review.
problem.phone: No phone number in the story.
problem.pseudonym_digits: The pseudonym must not contain a long series of digits.
problem.pseudonym_email: Do not use the beginning of your email address as a pseudonym.
problem.pseudonym_invalid: Pseudonym: 3 to 24 letters, digits, “-” or “_”, no space and no “@”.
problem.pseudonym_reserved: This pseudonym could pass for an official or moderation account.
problem.pseudonym_taken: This pseudonym is already in use: choose another one.
reason.personal_data: Personal data (a person's name, address, contact)
report.done: Thank you. The story will be reviewed by the moderators.
report.login: To report a story, sign in to your account: an account is needed to prevent abusive reports.
